title: Identify the patient with the highest total bilirubin level who also has no
question: Identify the patient with the highest total bilirubin level who also has no thrombosis and an abnormal creatinine phosphokinase level. Return their age at the time of the laboratory test, sex, and diagnosis.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    T3."XCL_016" AS age_at_test,
    T1."XCL_059" AS sex,
    T1."XCL_064" AS diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1."XCL_058" = T3."XCL_014"
WHERE T2."XCL_013" = 0
  AND T3."XCL_028" >= 250
ORDER BY T3."XCL_037" DESC
LIMIT 1
